zones.name: Parc des Buttes-Chaumont: paths open to bikes
zones.note: owner, 2026-10-30, 48.880332, 2.383315: the two bridges to the island have 'no rideable way'. Footways, so the bike graph left them out, and the island's paths with them. Ring: OSM's park outline.

zones.name: Trocadéro: the parvis, the Place, the theatre terrace and the lower terrace
zones.note: owner, 2026-11-03: sand showed through the terraces. The 20 m ground smeared the 12 m drop under the Place (lidar: parvis 61, Place 59.5, theatre terrace 47, lower terrace 46) into a slope over the trocaderoParvis model. Fine ground (IGN lidar at 4 m) here.

zones.name: Parc des Buttes-Chaumont: the wooded hill
zones.note: owner, 2026-11-05: 'not densely forested enough'. Scattered trees on top of the register's, off the lake (map/format.ts thicket). Ring: OSM's park outline.
